preconditions.description: The number of brains n must be between 2 and 200000.
The length of the list p must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list p must be a positive integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain n - 1 space-separated numbers.
Each latency value in the output must be a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: any(int(latency) == i for i in range(1, n) for latency in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output must include at least one latency value equal to each integer from 1 to n - 1.
